## SQL Table Columns — The Definitive Schema

The full column list is at **`g:\0.0.0.Dashboard\cd-21\sql\SIM_Student.sql`**. Below are the date/time-related columns you specifically asked about:

### Date / DateTime Columns

| Column Name | Purpose |
|-------------|---------|
| `BirthDay` | Day of birth |
| `BirthMonth` | Month of birth |
| `BirthYear` | Year of birth |
| `BirthDateText` | Birth date as text (Vietnamese) |
| `BirthDateTextEn` | Birth date as text (English) |
| `PersionIDDate` | *(likely PersonIDDate)* — ID card issue date |
| `PersonIDExpired` | ID card expiry date |
| `PersonIDReceivedDate` | ID card received date |
| `LiveFromDate` | Start of residence/dorm period |
| `LiveToDate` | End of residence/dorm period |
| `ReceivedDate` | Date received/registered |
| **`RealLearningDate`** | **Actual enrollment/start learning date** |
| **`CreatedDate`** | **Record creation timestamp** |
| **`UpdatedDate`** | **Last update timestamp** |
| `DeletedDate` | Soft delete timestamp |
| `UnionJoinedDate` | Union membership join date |
| `ImportDate` | Data import date |
| `VisaDate` | Visa issue date |

| `StayExpired` | Stay permit expiry |
| `NextReceiptPlanDate` | Next fee receipt plan date |
| `NextReceiptPlanUpdatedDate` | When the next receipt plan was updated |

### Key Columns for Your Questions

- **Enrollment / start learning**: `RealLearningDate` — this is the column that tracks when a student actually started/enrolled.
- **Status change tracking**: There is **no dedicated "StatusChangedDate" column**. The `SIM_Student` table has a `Status` column (int: 1 = studying, 2 = graduated, 3 = suspended), but no separate column records *when* that status changed. You would need to infer status change time from:
  - `UpdatedDate` (last time any field was modified)
  - `DeletedDate` (if status changed to deleted)
- **Audit columns**: `CreatedDate`, `CreatedUser`, `UpdatedDate`, `UpdatedUser`, `IsDeleted`, `DeletedDate`, `DeletedUser` — standard audit trail columns.

### Other Notable Non-Date Columns

| Column | Type / Notes |
|--------|-------------|
| `Status` | int — 1=studying, 2=graduated, 3=suspended (from SQL file comments) |
| `StudentCollectionID` | Collection/batch ID |
| `StudentCollectionGroupID` | Group within collection |
| `CourseID` | Course/program ID |
| `ClassID` | Class ID |
| `SchoolID` | School ID |
| `LevelStudentID` | Student level |
| `PromotionID` | Promotion/discount |

---

## Summary

- **No C# class file** (`SIM_Student.cs`) exists in this codebase — the class comes from the compiled `SimsObject.dll` (external project `SIMS-CD-Nghe21-2025`).
- **No BO/DAL/DAO layers** in this project — data access is handled entirely through `SimsObject` wrapper classes.
- **`RealLearningDate`** is the column for tracking when a student enrolled/started.
- **`CreatedDate` / `UpdatedDate`** are the standard audit date columns.
- **No dedicated "StatusChangedDate"** column exists; status change timing would need to be inferred from `UpdatedDate` or tracked in a separate audit/log table.
